purpose: A tool that turns a recorded interview into a publish-ready article, running every recording through the same editorial production process.
target_audience: Content teams that publish interview write-ups regularly
Solo writers who record and want a consistent output

article_production.description: A user uploads an interview recording and receives a finished, house-styled article. Every recording goes through the same production: a transcript is produced, the key quotes and themes are pulled out, a draft is written around them, and the house style is applied — the same stages in the same order for every upload, each intermediate available to review.
article_production.example: A 30-minute recording becomes a 900-word styled article, with the transcript and pulled quotes viewable underneath.

review_intermediates.description: Users can open the transcript, the pulled quotes, and the draft at each stage and re-run from any point.

differentiators: The same reliable production process for every recording, with every stage reviewable.
